latestVersion.changelog:
163mail v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides 163.com email sending and receiving via IMAP/SMTP.
- Supports inbox viewing, folder management, email reading, searching, sending, replying, forwarding, and deletion with slash commands.
- Configuration and authorization code setup instructions included.
- Environment variable support for sensitive info.
- Attachment handling not supported in current version.
- Troubleshooting guidance for common errors.
